name: Mi 4

images.credit: https://www.flickr.com/people/136966778@N03 Thomas Nilsson, CC BY-SA 2.0 via Wikimedia Commons

Network.Technology: GSM, CDMA, WCDMA, 3G, EVDO, HSDPA and optionally LTE

Platform.Operating system: Original: MIUI v5 (Android 4.4 Kitkat), Current: MIUI 9 (Android 6.0 Marshmallow), Windows 10 Mobile (up to version 1607) released 2015-12-03
Platform.CPU: 2.5 GHz Qualcomm Snapdragon 801 MSM8974AC Quad-Core Krait 400

Display.Display: 5 inch diagonal, (16:9 aspect ratio), multi-touch display, LED backlit IPS TFT LCD, 1080x1920 pixels at 441 ppi

Cameras.Rear camera: 13 MP back-side illuminated sensor, HD video (2160p) at 30 frame/s, IR filter, dual warm/cool LED flashes, aperture f/1.8, facial recognition, image stabilization, burst mode
